content: Istir tedweř d tajeǧidt n jdid
Awarni man aya, umi yarsa wesɛar n ujeǧid, idweř ittxemmam deg Wacti d min tegga u di min xas ittwaggen n řeḥkam.
Xenni nnan imsexxaren iḥuḍriyyen n ujeǧid i tuɣa i d as ittsexxaren: “Ejj ad arzun tibřiɣin i ujeǧid, tiɛezriyyin i di iǧa weẓri.

Ejj ajeǧid ad igg iweqqafen x marra lɛamalat n tgeldit nnes, ad ssmunen marra tibřiɣin tiɛezřiyin nni di iǧa weẓri, ɣar lqelɛa n Cucan, ɣar taddart n temɣarin, sadu i tɛessast n Hijay, amsexxar amcenneɛ n ujeǧid wenni d aɛessas x temɣarin u ad asent wcen timesřayin i uthelli n weẓri.
Tabřiɣt i ɣa iɛejben i ujeǧid ad tiři d tajeǧidt deg wemcan n Wacti.” Tuɣa awař-a d lemliḥ di tiṭṭawin n ujeǧid uca netta igga ammu.
Tuɣa din ijj n weryaz d Uday di lqelɛa n Cucan, qqaren as Murdaxay, mmis n Ya’ir, mmis n Cimɛi, mmis n Kis, ijj n weryaz zeg ayt n Binyamin.
Netta ittwandeh zi Urcalim ak-d ayt n lmenfa nni dd-iwyen ak-d Yakunya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, inni umi indeh Nabuxadnaṣṣar, ajeǧid n Babil, di lmenfa.

D netta wenni tuɣa isseymen Hadassa, ixs ad yini Istir, yeǧis n ɛemmis, minzi war ɣares tuɣi ɛad babas niɣ yemmas. Nettat tuɣa d ict n tebřiɣt s ijj n waddud icuwwar u dayes aẓri. Awarni umi immut babas d yemmas, iksi tt Murdaxay, igga i-tt d yeǧis.

Ařami ittwassen wawař n ujeǧid d řqanun nnes uca ttwassmunent aṭṭas n tebřiɣin di lqelɛa n Cucan sadu i tɛessast n Hijay, imsar belli sseɛdun Istir ɛawed ɣar taddart n ujeǧid, tedweř sadu tɛessast n Hijay, aɛessas n temɣarin.

Teɛjeb as tabřiɣt u nettat tusa as-dd x řxaḍar di tiṭṭawin nnes. Netta iqeǧeq ḥima ad as iwc timesřayin i uthelli n weẓri d macca nnes, u ḥima ad as iwc uřa d sebɛa n temsexxarin timeẓyanin ittwaxḍaren zi taddart n ujeǧid, uca issmuṭṭiy i-tent ɣar wemcan icnan qaɛ di taddart n temɣarin.
Istir war txebbar ca řgens nnes niɣ jjadira nnes, minzi Murdaxay iweṣṣa tt maḥend war t teqqar ca.
Tuɣa Murdaxay iggur kuř ass zzat i řemřah i iǧan zzat i taddart n temɣarin maḥend ad issen mammec teǧa Istir d min d as ɣa imsaren.

Tabřiɣt awarni tenneɣni tas as-dd nnubet ḥima ad tadef ɣar ujeǧid Aḥacwiruc, awarni tenɛac n uyuren n uzeyyen am mammec teǧa tewṣeyyet i temɣarin, minzi ammu i ttwakemmřen wussan n uthelli n weẓri: setta n uyuren s zzect n mirru d setta n iyuren s řeɛṭur ittfuḥen d fumadat i temɣarin.
Ammu dd-tusa kuř ict n tebřiɣt ɣar ujeǧid: marra min tᵉttar, immewc as maḥend ad zzayes teffeɣ zi taddart n temɣarin ɣar taddart n ujeǧid.

Ɣar tmeddit tudef ɣar daxeř u ɣar tuffut teɛqeb-dd ɣar taddart wiss tnayen n temɣarin sadu uḥeṭṭu n Caɛacɣaz, amsexxar amcenneɛ n ujeǧid, aɛessas n tiyya. War dd-teɛqeb ɣar ujeǧid, mɣir mařa teɛjeb as i ujeǧid uca tᵉttwařaɣa s yisem nnes.

Řami dd-tiweḍ nnubet n Istir, yeǧis n Abiḥayil, ɛemmis n Murdaxay, wenni tt yarrin d yeǧis, war tᵉttar walu mɣir min inna Hijay, amsexxar amcenneɛ n ujeǧid, aɛessas n temɣarin. U Istir tusa-dd x řxaḍar i marra wi tt iẓrin.
Ammu i iwyen Istir ɣar ujeǧid Aḥacwiruc, ɣar taddart nnes igellden, deg uyur wiss ɛecra, aqa-t d uyur n Ṭibit, deg useggʷas wiss sebɛa n tgelda nnes.

Ajeǧid tuɣa ittexs Istir x marra timɣarin nneɣni uca nettat tufa arḍa d řeḥnunect zzat i wudem nnes ktar x marra tiɛzuray nneɣni. Issars ttaj igellden x uzeǧif nnes uca yarra i-tt d tajeǧidt deg wemcan n Wacti.
Igga ujeǧid ict n zzardet tameqqrant i marra řḥukkam nnes d imsexxaren nnes, zzardet n Istir. Igga řehna di marra lɛamalat u iwca arriɣaluten ɛlaḥsab tizemmar n ujeǧid.
Murdaxay ibḍeř aneqqi n ujeǧid
Xmi ttwassmunent tiɛzuray ɛawed, iqqim Murdaxay ɣar tewwart n ujeǧid.
Istir war txebbar ca i jjadira nnes niɣ i řgens nnes, am mammec d as yumur Murdaxay, minzi Istir tuɣa teggur ɛlaḥsab řumur n Murdaxay am mammec tuɣa tᵉttegg umi tuɣa ɣares tᵉttwarebba.

Deg wussan nni, am iqqim Murdaxay di tewwart n ujeǧid, tuɣa Biɣtan d Tarac, tnayen n imsexxaren icennɛen n ujeǧid zeg iɛessasen n tewwart, ttfuggmen aṭṭas u tuɣa arezzun ad sswiẓẓḍen afus ɣar ujeǧid Aḥacwiruc.
Tamesřact-a tedweř tᵉttwassen ɣar Murdaxay uca netta ixebbar i-tt i tjeǧidt Istir, uca Istir tenna man aya i ujeǧid s yisem n Murdaxay.
Arzun di tmesřact nni uca ufin man aya d tidett. Uyřen ten s tnayen x teḥnact uca uran t deg wedlis n imezruyen zzat i wudem n ujeǧid.
